description_en: Lists the application groups that Smart Access Gateway supports in a specified region
description_zh: 查询指定地域下智能接入网关支持的应用组信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag list-dpi-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token FFPSpX59Eb0000 --max-results 3 --dpi-group-ids example-string --dpi-group-names example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDpiGroups

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the regions and their IDs that Smart Access Gateway supports
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of application groups to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
列表分页查询时每页展示的应用组个数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The application group ID.

You can query information about one or more application groups by specifying their IDs. You can query up to 10 application groups at a time
parameters.help_zh:
应用组ID。

系统允许您通过应用组ID指定查询一个或多个应用组信息，您一次最多可以查询10个指定的应用组信息
parameters.name: dpi_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The application group name.

You can query information about one or more application groups by specifying their names. You can query up to 10 application groups at a time
parameters.help_zh:
应用组名称。

系统允许您通过应用组名称指定查询一个或多个应用组信息，您一次最多可以查询10个指定的应用组信息
parameters.name: dpi_group_names

DpiGroupId.description_en: The ID of the application group

DpiGroupName.description_en: The name of the application group

MinEngineVersion.description_en: The minimum version of the deep packet inspection (DPI) engine that supports the application group
MinEngineVersion.description_zh: 支持该应用组的最低引擎版本

MinSignatureDbVersion.description_en: The minimum version of the signature database that supports the application group
MinSignatureDbVersion.description_zh: 支持该应用组的最低特征库版本

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next page of results

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of application groups returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 当前接口查询出来的应用组总个数
